svg.title: A made-up gene, G1, with two transcripts: T1 has exons E1, E2 and E3, and T2 has E1 and E3. In GFF3, exon E2 says ID=E2;Parent=T1; in GTF, it says gene_id "G1"; transcript_id "T1";
svg.text: In GFF3, each line names its own ID and its parent's
Column 9 of exon E2, written two ways
